title: Read through a cache
description: One read from the client's request to its response, as one motion.

chapters.label: Request
chapters.caption: The client sends a read to the API.

chapters.label: Check cache
chapters.caption: The API checks the cache first.

chapters.label: Cache miss
chapters.caption: The cache misses, so the read goes on to the database.

chapters.label: Database
chapters.caption: The database returns the row, and the cache keeps a copy.
